Name: Run Code Execution Agent Sandbox
Author: cbf81976-f755-4f3f-83fd-a1b7e124ac7f
Description: Launches a Google ADK Agent equipped with a secure, isolated Python execution sandbox (Vertex AI Agent Engine Sandbox). The agent dynamically writes, executes, and inspects Python code to solve complex analytical tasks such as log parsing, mathematical computations, data transformations, or nested JSON parsing.

Parameters.DefaultValue: Calculate the first 10 numbers in the fibonacci sequence
Parameters.Description: The analytical task or computation instruction for the code execution agent.
Thinking budget (token count) for model reasoning (e.g. 1024).
Optional Vertex AI Agent Engine resource path (e.g. 'projects/.../reasoningEngines/...'). If omitted, falls back to integration configuration.
Whether to equip the agent with persistent long-term memory via Vertex AI Memory Bank.
Optional session identifier to scope memory context. Defaults to active case ID (case_<CaseId>).
